## About

A versus card for a local club's social channels and stadium screen, made in one graphic clip
with no footage. A four-point path shape cuts the frame diagonally into the home navy and the
away red. The team names show three text treatments: a solid fill with a hard drop shadow, an
outline only (fill off, centered stroke), and the yellow VS with two strokes, black 8 px inside
a yellow 16 px. The fixture line is a text layer on a white rounded Background. The sides slide
in, the names fly in from the edges and the VS pops past 100 % before it settles.
